named_module: Autonomous bounded consumption of two already-controlled source operands through actual MiningController role/tool/transport boundaries; module record_deferred-intent stop only.

sections: acceptance correct source/namespace/unit/period/value and allowed gaps

obligations.definition_mapping: Actor chooses refs/actions; bounded module source consumption.
obligations.must: Production author chooses its own allowed actions/order/ref handles from actual current request, and actually reads both current and prior whole source operands via read_span(fact_ref). A comparison/directory/ref membership alone does not prove source reading.
obligations.evidence: Exact raw requests, raw first/corrected answers, action validation/execution, two persisted full read receipts, final intent.
failure_examples: Given oracle refs or scripted path used as author answer.
Only one operand read; other merely inferred from opaque known_fact_refs.

obligations.definition_mapping: Exact-source namespace/concept/unit/period/value and no automatic namespace inference.
obligations.must: Any material operand/value/period/unit/namespace/sign/comparison claim agrees with the exact source rows in source-reference. Distinguish IFRS CashFlowsFromUsedInOperatingActivities from us-gaap NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActivities. Latest is scoped to this selected document.
obligations.evidence: Full read receipts plus source-linked final rationale; original raw metadata remains preserved by driver.
failure_examples: 1179 cash flow reported as positive, USD replaced by AUD, or prior raw fiscal_year rewritten as2023.
0770 nine-month YTD cash flows called standalone quarter cash flows.
Same English meaning treated as proof of automatic cross-taxonomy equivalence.
obligations.not_required: Rationale need not restate every original metadata field, raw value or raw fiscal-year decoration when it makes no contrary material claim. Source-link/read receipts must establish its material facts. Generic arithmetic is allowed but no ratio/delta is mandatory.

obligations.definition_mapping: Rationale states what established and uncertain; historical omissions and source scope remain explicit.
obligations.must: Final intent accurately conveys source-supported historical within-document OCF comparison/inspection and its material uncertainty: bounded one-document source scope cannot establish a cross-group predictive pattern, new reusable measurement, current/latest full-source conclusion or audited primary-filing truth. Concise combined qualification is sufficient.
obligations.evidence: Original assembled final intent compared with reference and actual tool ledger.
failure_examples: Claims a direction/magnitude Signal, candidate novelty, complete source coverage or cross-group predictive validity from the one-case pair.
Calls budget/module stop an unavailable-source/no-pattern finding.
obligations.not_required: No forced ratio, factor proposal, category quota, separate disclaimer list, or verbatim metadata recital.

obligations.definition_mapping: Structured read progress and executed comparison locators survive intervening actions.
obligations.must: Actual later request retains whole successful operand receipts; if compare_groups is used, current-to-prior mapping remains reachable from subsequent actual request and tied to unchanged fact/group/axis context. No hidden Python/oracle/previous-ref memory may rescue a missing current-wire mapping in preflight.
obligations.evidence: Per-step actual serialized request projections, receipts and comparison context snapshots; local preflight may establish wiring but is not fresh author compliance.
failure_examples: Prior locator lost after first read and reachable only from an earlier saved script variable.
Changed fact/group/axis context presents stale comparison as current.
obligations.not_required: No obligatory compare_groups or fixed action order when another permitted autonomous path satisfies both-operand reading.

obligations.definition_mapping: Dedicated boundary saves record_deferred intent before execution; module is not full seed/domain terminal.
obligations.must: Accept only assembled record_deferred intent as module endpoint and intercept before native terminal execution. Preserve raw/corrected intent and report module result, without manufacturing evidence_unavailable/deferred_budget/no_pattern native state or executing candidate/publication actions.
obligations.evidence: Boundary class/path, saved intent, ledger/state comparison before/after, terminal seal.
failure_examples: Native record_deferred executes and is then relabeled module success.
Module stop persisted as no-pattern or source unavailable.

Formal inbox follows reference/source/code freeze; terminal advance only verifies seal. Old actual0671 remains terminal at its original budget and1/2 remains.

failure_examples: Fifth old0671 request under new sample name.
Code/source/oracle hot changes, budget reset/top-up or omitted blocked request.

accepted_variation: Any supported autonomous allowed tool order.
Optional generic arithmetic accurately scoped to the exact pair.
Concise supported/unknown rationale without raw metadata recital.
Natural inability within frozen resources remains honest failure/deferral; it is not an automatic semantic pass.

reporting.first_answer: Separate initial behavior from accepted corrected behavior; report corrections and exhausted/blocked requests explicitly.
reporting.fresh_counter: This source/reference reviewer is not production author/fresh consumer; count only independently authored exact exchange answers.
reporting.closure_limit: Passing two controls establishes only named fresh source-consumption module evidence, not complete S3/S4, candidates, admission, publication, reuse, recovery, MVP or independent benefit.
